title: Hydrogenation of Carbon Monoxide by Tetranuclear Rare Earth Metal Polyhydrido Complexes. Selective Formation of Ethylene and Isolation of Well-Defined Polyoxo Rare Earth Metal Clusters

synthesis.procedure: Under argon/glovebox conditions, toluene (6 mL) was added to 1a (60 mg, 0.050 mmol) in a 50 mL Teflon-valve Schlenk tube. The colorless solution was frozen in liquid nitrogen, evacuated, and backfilled with CO (1 atm). While slowly warming to -10 °C with stirring, the solution turned pale yellow. After 3 min, volatiles were removed under reduced pressure. In the glovebox, THF/hexane (1:1) was added, the pale yellow solution was concentrated, and stored overnight at -30 °C to precipitate 2a as a pale yellow crystalline solid. Single crystals of 2a·C7H8 for X-ray analysis were grown from concentrated toluene at room temperature.
synthesis.temperature: -10 °C for reaction; -30 °C crystallization; RT crystal growth from toluene
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 50 mL Schlenk tube with Teflon valve; freeze–evacuate–backfill with CO; glovebox workup
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Volatiles removed under reduced pressure; THF/hexane (1:1) added, concentrated, stored overnight at -30 °C; X-ray crystals from toluene at RT.

synthesis.procedure: Toluene (4 mL) was added to 1b (78 mg, 0.050 mmol) in a 50 mL Teflon-valve Schlenk tube. The solution was frozen in liquid nitrogen, evacuated, and backfilled with CO (1 atm), then kept at -10 °C. After 3 min, volatiles were removed. In the glovebox, THF/hexane (1:2) was added, the colorless solution was concentrated, and stored a few hours at -30 °C to precipitate 2b as a white crystalline solid.
synthesis.time: 3 min reaction; a few hours crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 50 mL Schlenk tube with Teflon valve; freeze–evacuate–backfill with CO
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Volatiles removed; THF/hexane (1:2) added, concentrated, stored a few hours at -30 °C.

synthesis.procedure: Observed as a low-temperature NMR intermediate, not isolated as a bulk solid. In a J. Young NMR tube, 1a (12 mg, 0.0099 mmol) in THF-d8 (0.45 mL) was frozen, degassed, and treated with CO (1 atm) at -20 °C; spectra for assignment were recorded at -50 °C, showing major/minor (10:9) enolate isomers of 3. Related 13CO experiments used 1a (22 mg, 0.018 mmol) or 2a (15 mg, 0.012 mmol) in THF-d8. Warming to room temperature under argon converted 3 to 4 and ethylene.
synthesis.time: monitored after shaking; conversion to 4 after ~2 h at RT
synthesis.vessel_or_method: J. Young valve NMR tube; freeze–degas–backfill with CO
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Not isolated; converted to 4/ethylene on warming.

synthesis.procedure: Method a: THF (4 mL) was added to 1a (100 mg, 0.083 mmol) in a 50 mL Teflon-valve Schlenk tube. The solution was frozen, evacuated, backfilled with CO (1 atm), and stirred at -10 °C (colorless to pale yellow). After 10 min, the mixture was frozen, excess CO removed, and stirred at room temperature for 2 h. Volatiles were removed; hexane was added in the glovebox, the pale yellow solution concentrated, and stored overnight at -30 °C to give 4 (47 mg, 0.038 mmol, 46%). Method b: THF (6 mL) was added to 2a (83 mg, 0.067 mmol); freeze–evacuate–backfill with CO (1 atm); stirred at -10 °C for 5 min; excess CO removed; stirred 1 h at room temperature; analogous hexane crystallization gave 4 (49 mg, 0.040 mmol, 60%). Single crystals of 4·C7H8 were grown from concentrated toluene at room temperature.
synthesis.time: method a: 10 min at -10 °C then 2 h at RT; method b: 5 min at -10 °C then 1 h at RT; overnight crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 50 mL Schlenk tube with Teflon valve; freeze–evacuate–backfill with CO
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Volatiles removed; hexane added, concentrated, stored overnight at -30 °C; X-ray crystals from toluene at RT.

synthesis.procedure: Method a: In a J. Young NMR tube, 4 (43 mg, 0.015 mmol) in C6D6 (0.4 mL) was frozen, evacuated, and backfilled with CO (1 atm) at room temperature. After a few minutes, NMR showed clean formation of 5a and ethylene. Volatiles were removed; Et2O was added, the pale brown solution concentrated, and stored several days at -30 °C to precipitate 5a as a colorless crystalline solid (23 mg, 0.019 mmol, 54%). Method b: 1a (40 mg, 0.033 mmol) in C6D6 (0.4 mL) with CO (1 atm) at room temperature for 17 h also gave clean 5a by 1H NMR.
synthesis.time: a few minutes from 4; 17 h from 1a; several days crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: J. Young valve NMR tube; freeze–evacuate–backfill with CO
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Volatiles removed; Et2O added, concentrated, stored several days at -30 °C.

synthesis.procedure: Method a: In a J. Young NMR tube, 2b (50 mg, 0.032 mmol) in THF (0.5 mL) was frozen, evacuated, and backfilled with CO (1 atm) and kept at room temperature. After 2 days, volatiles were removed. In the glovebox, Et2O was added, the pale brown solution concentrated, and stored several days at -30 °C to precipitate 5b as a white crystalline solid (27 mg, 0.018 mmol, 56%). Single crystals for X-ray analysis were grown from concentrated Et2O at -30 °C. Method b: 1b (30 mg, 0.019 mmol) in THF-d8 (0.45 mL) with CO (1 atm) at room temperature for 5 days gave clean 5b and ethylene by 1H NMR.
synthesis.time: 2 days from 2b; 5 days from 1b; several days crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: J. Young valve NMR tube; freeze–evacuate–backfill with CO
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Volatiles removed; Et2O added, concentrated, stored several days at -30 °C; X-ray crystals from concentrated Et2O at -30 °C.
